holderQuote: The Nelgaunt took the ship forwards, guiding it more surely than Seve could. Through the waves. It was what had given him his name, and power. Each friend had been made ink, that they might not die, in the Empire of Drath.
But Seve had known it. The [Worldtraveller Inkfriend] closed his eyes.
It only occurred to Seve after he woke up in The Wandering Inn with a smile the next day
